purpose: Sanity-check scripts/p2_awq_activation_stats.py end-to-end against the real target model and real C4 data, before committing to the full n_samples=128 calibration run.

bug_found_and_fixed.description: src/awq_calibration.py's register_activation_hooks created the ActivationStats accumulator tensors (sum_abs, max_abs) with torch.zeros(in_features) -- no device argument, defaulting to CPU. The scripts/p2_awq_stats_verify.py toy test never caught this because its toy nn.Linear model was never moved to a device, so both the accumulator and the activation tensor happened to be on CPU. The real target model runs on mps:0, so the first real forward pass raised: 'RuntimeError: Expected all tensors to be on the same device, but found at least two devices, mps:0 and cpu!'
bug_found_and_fixed.fix: Allocate sum_abs/max_abs with device=x.device (the incoming activation tensor's device) instead of the implicit CPU default.
bug_found_and_fixed.lesson: Same category of lesson as the KV-cache work: a deterministic unit test passing does not guarantee correctness against the real model/hardware -- it only guarantees correctness of what it actually exercises. The toy test exercised the math; it never exercised device placement, because it never ran on anything but CPU.

consistency_check.description: q_proj, k_proj, v_proj within the same decoder layer all consume the exact same hidden_states input tensor in Qwen2's attention module. If the hook correctly captures INPUT (not output), their per-channel activation statistics must be byte-for-byte identical; if it accidentally captured OUTPUT, they would differ (each projects through a different weight matrix).
consistency_check.layer_count_check: 197 = 28 decoder layers x 7 Linear submodules (q/k/v/o_proj, gate/up/down_proj) + 1 lm_head -- matches Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct's known architecture (28 layers)
consistency_check.result: q_proj/k_proj/v_proj statistics matched exactly in both the dry run and the real C4 run -- an additional, incidental correctness signal beyond the hand-computed unit test, obtained for free from running on the real model

next_step: Run the full calibration collection: .venv/bin/python3 scripts/p2_awq_activation_stats.py --n-samples 128 (the default)
